newsitem.title: USA: El Salvador amends US PL-480 vegoil/tallow tenders.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador amends US PL-480 vegoil/tallow tenders.

text.p: El Salvador said it amended the delivery periods for its tender of 4,500 to 5,500 tonnes of U.S. vegoil under the PL-480 Title I export program, according to its shipping agent, International Services Corp.
Shipping dates, originally slated for April 21-May 6, could alternatively be May 1-15 at buyer's option, it said.
It also amended the shipping period for its tender of about 2,000 to 3,000 tonnes of U.S. tallow in bulk under the PL-480 Title I export program.
Shipment was set for April 21-May 6 or alternatively, at buyer's option, May 1-15, it said.

Separate price quotations are requested for each delivery period. Offers for both the vegoil and tallow tenders are to be received no later than April 14 and all offers must remain valid through April 15, the agent said.
